tools.name: list_certifications
tools.description: List the professional certifications Examova prepares learners for (CIPS Level 4, PMP, PRINCE2 7 Foundation, Business English) with provider, edition and links. Call this first to see what is available.

tools.name: get_exam_info
tools.description: Current public exam facts for one certification: edition, exam format (question count, time, pass mark where the issuer publishes a fixed one), PMP domain weights, and links to its module pages. CIPS Level 4 assessments vary by module, so its facts are given per module.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List the modules (units) of a certification with their code, title, assessment type and page link. Use it to find the right module before get_module_info or search_practice_questions.

tools.name: get_module_info
tools.description: Overview of one module: description, assessment type and the learning-outcome titles it covers. Titles only; study text stays in Examova Pro.

tools.name: search_practice_questions
tools.description: Return curated Examova public-preview practice questions for a certification, optionally filtered by module or keyword. Use it to quiz the user: show the stem and options, let them answer, then reveal correctLabel. Returns the question, options and correct answer letter; full explanations and the co

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Examova's free public study guides and exam-tip articles (blog). Returns titles, summaries and links; use get_guide to read one in full.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read one free public Examova study guide in full (Markdown) by its slug from search_guides. Cite the guide URL when you use it.

tools.name: get_exam_schedule
tools.description: CIPS Level 4 exam sessions (2026-2027): booking windows, objective and written exam dates, and results dates, plus the next upcoming session. Dates are set by CIPS and can change; confirm on the CIPS website before booking.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Examova plans: what the free tier includes and the Pro prices (USD, billed per certification), trial and cancellation terms.

tools.name: compare_certifications
tools.description: Compare certifications side by side (provider, edition, exam format and pass mark where the issuer publishes one). Pass slugs, or omit to compare all. Verify high-stakes facts with the issuer.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search everything public on Examova at once: certifications, modules and study guides. Returns typed results with URLs. Good first call when the user's topic is vague.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Links to start using Examova: free demo exam, free account (5 questions/day) and Pro pricing; optionally deep-linked to a certification.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_certifications" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the certifications Examova offers (e.g. CIPS Level 4, PMP, Business English) with a short description and how many practice questions each has. Use this first to see what is available." → after: "List the professional certifications Examova prepares learners for (CIPS Level 4, PMP, PRINCE2 7 Foundation, Business English) with provider, edition and links. Call this first to see what is available."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
